name: Artificial Analysis benchmarks DeepSeek Search: 69 on its Search Index, cheapest paid search API
title: Artificial Analysis benchmarks DeepSeek Search: 69 on its Search Index, cheapest paid search API
summary: DeepSeek's new Search API scored 69 (17th of 27) in an agent harness running BrowseComp, DeepSearchQA and AA-Omniscience tasks, at $0.75 per 1k searches, the lowest per-search price measured. It returns about 7k tokens per search and rejects queries over 128 characters.
